questions.question: A patient is lying on the left side. How should the EMT interpret anatomic descriptions of the patient’s body?

choices.text: Use the standing, forward-facing position with palms forward as the reference
Use the patient’s current position as the reference for anterior and posterior
Reverse left and right when approaching the patient from the front

incorrectChoiceExplanations.C: Left and right refer to the patient, not the observer.
incorrectChoiceExplanations.D: In anatomic position, palms face forward.

questions.question: During elbow flexion, the biceps contracts while the triceps relaxes. What principle does this illustrate?

One pulls the bone while the other pushes it back through its tendon
